novels.description:
With the rising tide of steam power and machinery, who can come close to being a Beyonder? Shrouded in the fog of history and darkness, who or what is the lurking evil that murmurs in our ears?

Waking up to face a string of mysteries, Zhou Mingrui finds himself reincarnated as Klein Moretti in an alternate Victorian-era world. He discovers a realm filled with machinery, cannons, dreadnoughts, airships, difference engines, as well as potions, divination, hexes, tarot cards, and sealed artefacts.

The Light continues to shine, but mystery has never gone far. Follow Klein as he becomes entangled with the Churches of the world—both orthodox and unorthodox—whilst he slowly develops newfound powers thanks to the Beyonder potions. Like the corresponding tarot card, The Fool, which is numbered 0—a number of unlimited potential—this is the legend of “The Fool.”

novels.author: Cameron_Rose_8326
novels.title: Reborn To Change My Fate
novels.description:
PS: FL isn’t a pushover
In her previous life, Marissa Austen and her sister, Ashlyn Austen were forced to choose between two men―Derek Thompson. The Grand Duke of Denver. He’s the cold, unfeeling older brother and Carlos Thompson. The bastard son of the Thompsons. He’s the charming, magnetic younger brother. Ashlyn chose Derek, convinced it was her path to luxury. But when she found her husband forever absent and unloving, whispers of his infidelity spread and was eventually thrown out of the duchy, envy consumed her. Meanwhile, Marissa’s husband was rising in power, day by day closing the gap with his brother and finally gaining the title of the Grand Duke. Blinded by jealousy, Ashlyn dragged them both to their deaths.
When Marissa opened her eyes, she was back on the day their wedding carriages were arriving at the church’s courtyard. This time, Ashlyn insisted she switch carriage with Marissa. Her intention: To take the younger brother. But she never knew the truth: every of his achievements were because of Marissa, and he was not what he seemed. And Marissa was only too glad to claim the older brother as her own. What does fate have in store for the two sisters?

novels.title: Shattered Empire
novels.description:
At six years old, I can see the future. Yet I have never seen one in which I escape the curse of my own blood.

I was born in the Balah, the space between worlds, where no child should survive. My father was a legendary ruler. My cousins inherited extraordinary powers. I inherited his name, a bloodline they despise, and a future that will not leave me alone.

Then, during the sacred First Baptism, my own blood tries to murder me.

I survive.

And from the depths of Nenuphar, I emerge bearing something the empire has not seen in an age: the white-gold torq of the ancient Autarch. A mark of power that should be impossible.

But the future has gone dark to me. Something else has awakened in its place.

Something hungry.

Now House Azure wants to control what I am becoming, the Exarchs question what I truly am, and beyond the palace waits the Mere, where the empire's children are forged into warriors, conquerors, and monsters.

They call me contaminated.

Balah-touched.

Eater.

I have survived my birth. I have survived my baptism. And I will survive whatever comes next.

Even if I must become the monster they already believe me to be.

What to Expect

Dark progression fantasy: Rare powers, dangerous advancement, formidable enemies, and an imperial hierarchy built upon the conquest of the Hells.

An intelligent, underestimated protagonist: A young heir navigating betrayal, deadly trials, and powers he does not fully understand.

A vast science-fantasy world: Shattered dimensions, ancient civilizations, rival noble houses, and mysteries reaching beyond the known universe.

Power with consequences: Political intrigue, psychological horror, brutal combat, and transformations that may cost more than they grant.

Long-form storytelling: Layered mysteries, carefully planted revelations, and an escalating journey from a rejected child toward something far greater.

associated_names: 吞噬进化：万倍修炼速度
novels.description: Lin Yi found himself in a martial arts world after transmigrating. He starts in a critically wounded state, teetering on the brink of death. All he possesses is a rundown thatched hut and a younger sister, who is his sole family member. After five years of trying to become a martial artist and failing, Lin Yi feels as though disaster is imminent. Natural disasters, human-made calamities, demons, and savage beasts—each of these could spell doom for an ordinary individual like him. Lin Yi's singular aim is to ensure his younger sister's survival! Just when he feels completely helpless, he awakens the Devouring System! By absorbing cultivation techniques, he can elevate his cultivation rate ten thousand times! He can devour ferocious beasts to acquire the Fire Spirit Orb! He can consume magical artifacts to gain the Soul-Destroying Curse! He can devour other martial artists to attain a unique physique! From that point forward, Lin Yi and his sister set off on an unending journey of devouring and evolution.

novels.title: MTL-Cultivation: I can solidify equipment attributes
associated_names: 修仙：我能固化装备属性
novels.description: Upon waking, Li Yuan found himself a low-level inspector in Qinghe Market, bound by a contract of servitude. He initially thought he was destined for the bottom rungs of the cultivation world, but then he discovered he had an equipment slot. Placing items in this slot granted special [attribute] bonuses. Equipping a [Low-Grade Spirit Stone] granted the [Spiritual Energy Filtering] attribute, increasing cultivation speed by 30% and automatically removing impurities from spiritual energy. Equipping a [Millennial Lingzhi Mushroom] granted the [Unending Vitality] attribute, greatly increasing injury recovery speed and enabling limb regeneration. Equipping a [True Dragon's Reverse Scale] granted the [All Laws Repelled] attribute, granting immunity to basic elemental spell damage and high-level resistance to rule-based suppression. ...Even more powerful, under certain conditions, these attributes could be [permanently solidified], freeing up the equipment slot for new items! ...Several years later. Looking at the numerous permanent attributes on his body: [Immune to All Laws], [Heaven Rewards Diligence], [Immortality], [One Sword to Open the Heavens], Li Yuan shrugged and said, "My talent is average; I rely entirely on my equipment."

novels.author: Your Molly
novels.title: Across Time, Through the Glowing Vase
novels.description:
My parents left me with nothing but an old vase.

I belong from a very middle class family and like almost every other middle class family, they want a boy not a girl. When i was of 10 my little brother born and after that they never actually paid attention towards me. Their all attention turns towards my little brother. I was getting neglected and getting blamed for every single thing.

Now i had turn 18 and they threw me out of the house saying I'm legally enough big to live on my own...

All they gave me is an old vase and said " We gave you the most useful thing we had". Yeah!! A useful thing which you never even ever paid attention too!

novels.title: I Was An F-Rank Hunter Until I Found A World With EXP
novels.description:
Kang Jin lost his Awakening combat exam to a pigeon. Specifically, a diagram of an adult pigeon hitting a glass door at forty-two joules.

For three years, his F-rank Wayfarer status stayed frozen at Level 1 while he scraped by on dungeon cleanup shifts, bad vending-machine coffee, and trying to pay his sister’s school fees. Then a spatial fracture in Gate F-04 drops him into a violet-skied world where dead monsters dissolve into light—and his dust-covered EXP bar actually moves.

There’s just one problem. The System’s Quest Compiler doesn’t care about heroic speeches. It pays bonus EXP for asking apex predators to fetch their manager, fighting E-rank scammers while cooing like a dove, signing a boss monster’s face with a pink marker, and draping yellow duck-print trousers over an arena beast’s head.

What to Expect (Or: Why Your Brain Cells Are in Danger):

A Masterclass in Weapons-Grade Stupidity: Watch the author invent deeply stupid problems and force the protagonist to solve them with even stupider, mathematically verified solutions. Need to survive a sonic-blasting ape? Demand a standing ovation. Fighting a B-rank celebrity? Sell him a ₩1,000 front-row ticket to his own defeat and hit him with a plastic chair.

An HR Department From Hell: A System that refuses to reward normal heroics, acting instead like a sleep-deprived career counselor on questionable substances—handing out millions of EXP for officiating a wedding between two homicidal birds, singing a love song to your own reflection in a noodle shop, and conducting a job interview mid-fistfight.

Shameless Cliffhanger Addiction & Infinite Bingeing: Compact, fast-paced ~1,000-word chapters engineered specifically to ruin your sleep schedule. Every chapter ends exactly where your self-control dies.

Zero Edgelord Brooding, 100% Customer-Service Violence: An MC who treats eldritch horrors likeunreasonable retail customers, an S-rank girlfriend who actually enjoys the chaos, a crippled dancer best friend who weaponizes sarcasm, and a myna bird that charges one copper coin for life advice.

A Free Course in Writing Under the Influence of Gravel: Proof that you can build a rock-solid, down-to-the-single-digit LitRPG math engine and use it entirely to calculate the tactical advantage of wearing yellow duck boxers in a gladiator pit.

Discord

You are researching the evolution scheme for the rare Beastmaster Blastoise!] [The first option evolves into Water Turtle Excellent (Three-Star) after one evolution] [The second option consists of two evolutions, leading to a Tsunami Turtle (perfect five-star)] The third option includes five evolutions, culminating in the Xuanwu Divine Turtle Mythical. From Blastoise to the legendary beast Xuanwu. From the Crimson Sun Bird to the Immortal Phoenix. From Gale Shadow Cat to Nine Nether Demon Tiger. From the white-scaled fish to the Kunpeng soaring through the heavens. The alien powerhouse exclaimed, "A body larger than the stars! What a terrifying beast this is!" The gods of all races cried out, "Damn it! He's surrounded by ancient divine beasts, how are we supposed to fight him?"
